# -- tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_grant_reward_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_grant_reward_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_total_favorable value = 0 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_total_favorable add = var:tv_wonder_alhambra_treaty_clause_register_favorable_count }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_total_favorable add = var:tv_wonder_alhambra_palace_risk_points_favorable_count }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_total_favorable >= 8 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_total_favorable >= 5 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 6
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_reward_modifier_lesser years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 2
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_total_favorable
	tv_wonder_alhambra_treaty_clause_register_cleanup_write_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_alhambra_palace_risk_points_cleanup_write_effect = yes
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_row_set_index
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_completed value = 1 }
	tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
}

# -- tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_monthly_progress_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_monthly_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_alhambra_active_trigger = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_row_set_index ?= 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase ?= 0 tv_wonder_alhambra_war_validated_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1686 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase ?= 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1687 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase ?= 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { tv_wonder_alhambra_treaty_clause_register_has_contested_entity_trigger = yes }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1688 days = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1689 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase ?= 3 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_row_set_index add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_row_set_index ?= 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase ?= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1690 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase ?= 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1691 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase ?= 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { tv_wonder_alhambra_palace_risk_points_has_contested_entity_trigger = yes }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1692 days = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1693 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase ?= 3 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_row_set_index add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# -- tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_start_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_start_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_row_set_index value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_phase value = 0 }
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_pending_event
}
